tasks.spec: FAISS index at backend/data/vector_store/. Embeddings sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (lazy-load the model). ingest(path): ONLY accepts paths under backend/content/ (a public-content dir) - raise ValueError otherwise; chunk md/txt to ~500-char windows; add to index with metadata {source, chunk}. retrieve(query, k=5) -> list[{text, source, score}]. A guard assert_public(text) that rejects anything containing digits-looking-like-account-numbers or the words from a small denylist; used before ingest.

If backend/content/ is empty, write 3 short PUBLIC primer .md files (direct vs regular plans; expense ratio / TER; emergency fund basics) - generic educational text, no user data. Then call services.rag.ingest on each. Idempotent (skip if already indexed).

APIRouter: /learning/topics (list from indexed sources), /learning/topic/{id} (retrieve chunks for that topic), /learning/personalized (pick topics from portfolio/debt SHAPE - e.g. holds regular funds -> 'direct vs regular' - but the returned CONTENT is the public chunks, carrying no identifying strings). Never echo account/holding/lender names or descriptions into the response.

Retriever (wraps rag.retrieve), Personalizer (maps a portfolio/debt summary dict to a ranked topic list). __init__(self, llm_client). The llm only phrases the 'why this lesson' line, from aggregates only.
Topic list (left), topic reader (right, renders retrieved chunks), a personalized-lessons strip on top. Fetch via useFinanceData. Explicit empty state before ingestion has run.
